purpose: The exact upstream artifacts this repository's assurance lane reads, pinned by digest so a change upstream is a visible failure here rather than a silent change of meaning.
not_an_authority: This file pins artifacts. It does not restate component versions: the packaged Engineering Assurance compatibility matrix is the only authority on which versions are accepted, and scripts/check_shared_pins.py delegates every version verdict to it. A local copy of those numbers would be a second matrix that can drift from the one the acceptance decision was made against.

engineering_assurance.note: The tag is the released artifact. It must not be replaced by a branch head, and no v0.2.1 exists to reach for.

registry.rule: Every npm pin resolves from the public registry. npm.ix must not appear in any requirement, pin, lockfile or .npmrc in this repository, and is not an oracle for whether a release landed.

consumed_artifacts.why: Supplies classify_all and accepted, the only authority this repository's pin gate consults. Pinned by digest because a silent change here would silently change what `compatible` means.

deliberately_unpinned.why: Pinning its bytes here would make this repository a second acceptance authority. The installed matrix decides; this repository reports what it decided.

known_drift.statement: engineering-assurance v0.2.0 records accepted.state = pending_human_acceptance and ships no human_acceptance_recorded predicate. Both landed on that repository's main at ae50e13 after the tag, and no v0.2.1 was released. This repository reports the state the pinned release records, gates only on version compatibility, and does not synthesize an acceptance.
